decision_rule: A split is justified only when at least one mandatory reason is true and all required pre-split checks are complete.

required_pre_split_checks.description: Heavy runtime outputs are already fenced outside tracked repo truth.
Tracked file count and tracked size were measured from git-tracked files, not runtime directories.
Shared schemas, contracts, and operator policy surfaces were identified and kept centralized unless isolation is mandatory.
The operator can still discover experiments, artifact roots, and policy class from one central index.
The split rationale and rejected alternatives were written into durable governance evidence.

non_justifications: checkpoint or dataset size by itself
generated logs or receipts by themselves
desire for one repo per experiment as default style

close_rule.approve_only_if: all required_pre_split_checks are true and at least one mandatory_reason_key is true
